publicReleaseNotes: A monitor set to one minute is now probed every minute. It used to be probed about every 118 seconds. The minute Cron now runs only the work that is due, so a minute run stays within the CPU a Workers Free account allows. A sign-in link stays live, single use, when its mail send is uncertain (the mail service timed out, or answered with a server error), so the owner no longer gets a dead link and a second mail. With the mail service and owner-only recipients, sign-in mail goes through Base's owner relay sender, which refuses any recipient but the owner before the relay is called. The hosted demo deploys from published releases. The @runeditrun/rer pin moves from 0.2.131 to 0.2.137. No migration changes.
